receipts.detail: buildImage records the id the tag named before the build (imageIdOf) and, after a successful build, retirePreviousImage removes it when untagged and unused, without force; red before the fix (6 of 7 tests), green after

kept-tagged (another tag names it), kept-in-use (a container, running or stopped, uses it), kept-remove-failed (the daemon refuses, e.g. dependent child images), kept-unverified (a step cannot be read), none (no previous image, the same image, already gone); another dangling image is never touched and there is no prune; a failed build retires nothing; mutations of the tagged, in-use, same-image and removal-error guards each turn their test red; attempt 2: a pre-build read that fails other than 404 (500, ECONNREFUSED) is kept-unverified with the read error, never a fresh host; a post-build inspect or container listing that throws, or answers something that is not a list, is kept-unverified; a container matching by ImageID alone or by Image alone is kept-in-use; the listing asks for {all: true}; null and [] RepoTags count as untagged and are removed; a remove that answers 404 is none (already gone). Mutations M5, M6, M7, M8, M9, M15 and the F1, F4 (both), F7 guards each turn a test red (mutation-witnesses-attempt2.log.txt)

operation events image.retire-previous with stage recorded (previousId, before the build) and the outcome stage (previousId, currentId, detail) after it, through the provider's operation sink (the run's docker operation log); asserted in every test; attempt 2: the recorded event carries unreadable (the failed pre-build read), and test/distributed/run-runtime-helpers.js formatDockerOperationEvent prints image.retire-previous[<stage>] tag previous current detail on the verbose docker operation log (red before: the default branch dropped the fields, red-attempt2-run-log-line.log.txt)
